issuer.value: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development

business_day_convention.check: FT says Business Day Convention Not Applicable; FOLLOWING comes from the payment-day rule, which FT calls Condition 7(h) but Schedule 3 numbers 7(i) (7(h) is 'Not Used')

business_day.check: FT term 20 cites Condition 7(h); in the DNN conditions the 'business day' definition is in Condition 7(i)

notes: Schedule 3 of the DNN Prospectus Supplement (pages 7-23) replaces the Terms and Conditions of the 2021 Prospectus for Digitally Native Notes, so every definition is cited from ibrd-dnn-supplement-2023, not ibrd-gdif-2021. Day count: FT 'Actual/Actual (ICMA)' corresponds to Condition 5(l)(viii) 'Actual/Actual-ICMA' (the Day Count Fraction list starts on page 13, the ICMA clause is on page 15); no Determination Dates are specified, so they default to the Interest Payment Dates. Business day convention: FT 16(ii) says Interest Payment Dates are not subject to adjustment and 16(iv) says Business Day Convention Not Applicable; the payment-day rule in Condition 7(i) (page 20) postpones a payment to the next following business day without extra interest, and the modified-following variant applies only if specified, which the FT does not do. Interest periods are therefore unadjusted. Business day for payment: the Financial Centres London, TARGET and New York, plus a TARGET Business Day for euro payments. Calculation Amount is not specified; Condition 5(j) (page 13) makes it default to the minimum Specified Denomination (EUR 1,000). The first interest payment date is not printed: it follows from '23 October in each year' and the 23 October 2023 Issue Date. No coupon amount is printed (3.399% of EUR 1,000 would be EUR 33.99). No record date in the FT or in Schedule 3; the Record Date item in the DNN form of final terms (page 35) is optional and was not used. Rounding: Condition 5(i)(z), nearest unit of the currency with half a unit rounded up.
